name: Schengen 90/180 Day Calculator
description: Track entered Schengen stays against the rolling 90-days-in-180-days rule and estimate days used and remaining for a selected reference date.
search_intent: Calculate Schengen days used and remaining under the rolling 90/180-day short-stay rule.

inputs.label: Reference date
inputs.help: Date used to evaluate the rolling 180-day window.

inputs.label: Previous Schengen stays
inputs.help: Multiple arrival and departure date ranges.

calculation: For the selected reference date, examine the inclusive 180-calendar-day period ending on that date. Count each calendar day in entered Schengen stays that overlaps that rolling window, counting arrival and departure dates as stay days and avoiding double-counting overlapping trip ranges. Days remaining = 90 − days used, floored at zero for display. A user exceeding 90 days must still be clearly flagged as non-compliant rather than hiding excess days. Date handling must be timezone-safe and based on calendar dates, not browser-local elapsed hours.
limitations: This is a planning aid and not immigration or legal advice.
The user is responsible for entering complete and accurate travel history.
Visa type, residence permits, bilateral agreements and special legal circumstances are not automatically evaluated.
Users should verify important travel decisions with official Schengen/EU sources.
